blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—MJ Raymundo kept Emilio Aguinaldo College’s season alive on Thursday, willing the Generals to a 75-64 win over San Beda in Game 2 to force a decider in the Final Four at Mall of Asia Arena. Raymundo delivered 20 points, eight rebounds, and three assists as EAC forced a do-or-die game against the defending champions for a spot in the Finals.
